# PDF Processing Skill

## Instructions

When a user asks about PDFs:
1. Use `Read` to inspect the PDF file metadata
2. Use `Search` to find relevant text content
3. Use `Bash` with appropriate tools (e.g., `pdftotext`, `pdfinfo`) for extraction

## References

See `references/PDF_TOOLS.md` for detailed command examples.
